text:
Type: tall white five-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and accessories; bedroom, hallway, dressing area
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: solid pine with a white stain that shows the grain, small black metal knobs
Colors: white, black knobs
Shape: narrow upright chest with a shallow top drawer over four deeper ones, inset drawer fronts within a framed carcass, slightly overhanging top, short square legs, slim footprint
Feel: classic, fresh, homey, tidy
Goes with: light wood floors, grey or blue textiles, black accents; farmhouse, traditional or Scandinavian bedrooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
